en: Abu Muhammad Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Said ibn Hazm
tr: Ebû Muhammed Alî b. Ahmed b. Saîd İbn Hazm
ar: أبو محمد علي بن أحمد بن سعيد ابن حزم

description.tr: Tavku'l-Hamâme'yi yazdı — Avrupa saray aşkı geleneğini etkileyen bir aşk risalesi. Ayrıca dünya dinlerinin ilk sistematik karşılaştırmalı çalışmasını üretti || Kaynak materyali İbn Hazm'ı Endülüs derslerinde Tavku'l-Hamâme'nin yazarı olarak öne çıkarır. || [Tarih notu] Nykl'ın 1931 Tavku'l-Hamâme çevirisi İbn Hazm'ı Batı edebiyat eleştirisine tanıttı.
description.en: Wrote The Ring of the Dove — a treatise on love that influenced the European courtly love tradition. Also produced the first systematic comparative study of world religions, and championed the Zahiri (literalist) school of Islamic law || Source material highlights Ibn Hazm in the Andalusia richLectures as author of The Ring of the Dove (1022). His Fisal is the first attempt at systematic comparative religion — examining Islam, Christianity, Judaism, Zoroastrianism and other faiths with analytical rigor. He also championed the Zahiri (literalist) school of Islamic jurisprudence. || [Historiographical note] Nykl's 1931 translation of Tawq al-Hamama introduced Ibn Hazm to Western literary criticism. Arnaldez (1956) established the philosophical originality of al-Fisal.
description.ar: كتب طوق الحمامة — رسالة في الحب أثّرت في تقليد الحب النبيل الأوروبي. وأنتج أول دراسة منهجية مقارنة للأديان || يبرزه المصدر كمؤلف لطوق الحمامة. والفصل أول محاولة لعلم مقارنة الأديان — يفحص الإسلام والمسيحية واليهودية والزرادشتية بدقة تحليلية
